age.evidence: Swiss-Webster; male and female; 6-8 weeks; 30-40 g

sex.evidence: male and female Swiss Webster mice

dosing.evidence: Patches were cut to size prior to application. to deliver either 1 or 5 mg/kg of DMT... administered an IV tail vein injection of either DMT or vehicle

handling.evidence: All mice... were handled for 7 days prior to experimentation to acclimate to both the experimenter and vivarium.

group_housing.evidence: Mice were housed in groups of two or three under a 12h reverse light/dark cycle

assays.assay_description: Mice were placed in a magnetometer cage (15.24 cm height x 15.24 cm diameter) with implanted skull magnets; head twitches recorded for 60 min baseline + 60 min post-DMT administration (IV or transdermal patch) via automated magnetometer and Clampex/MATLAB analysis.

application_type.evidence: cohort 1: DMT IV + vehicle patch; cohort 2: vehicle IV + DMT patch

setup_habituation.evidence: Baseline activity recording in the magnetometer cage; no separate pre-test apparatus habituation described

setup_restrain.evidence: mice were placed in a magnetometer cage... placed immediately back into the magnetometer cage

food_restriction.evidence: All food (LabDiet) and water (Inno-Vive) were available to the mice ad libitum unless stated otherwise; testing in magnetometer cage without food

water_restriction.evidence: water available ad libitum in home cage; testing in magnetometer cage without water

time_to_assay.evidence: mice were administered the active treatment and placed immediately back into the magnetometer cage for another 60 min trial period

sample_size.evidence: intravenously (n = 5) or transdermally (n = 12) administered DMT at 5 mg/kg

outcomes.summary: Intravenous DMT (5 mg/kg) produced an 18-fold increase in head twitches relative to saline within 0-10 min post-administration, consistent with hallucinogenic-like activity. Transdermal DMT (5 mg/kg) did not significantly increase HTR vs. vehicle patch within 1 h.
outcomes.statistics: IV: Two-Way RM ANOVA FRoutexTime (11, 99) = 3.69, p = 0.0002; Sidak's p = 0.0214 at 0-10 min. TD: Two-Way RM ANOVA FRoutexTime (11, 242) = 0.66, p = 0.77
outcomes.evidence: significant 18-fold increase in head twitches relative to animals receiving IV saline at 0-10 min post-administration (Sidak's Multiple Comparisons, p = 0.0214)... the transdermal cohort did not show any significant variation in HTR's

B1_num_measures.evidence: HTR was assessed at each timepoint as a percent of the corresponding saline response

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: HTR was assessed at each timepoint... 0-10 min post-administration... next two chronological bins

B4_ethological.evidence: head-twitch response (HTR) - definitionally not ethological per rubric

B5_social.evidence: mice tested individually in magnetometer cage

B7_automated_classification.evidence: automated magnetometer approach with Clampex/MATLAB - signal detection, not behavioural classification from video

E1_environment_type.evidence: magnetometer cage (15.24 cm height × 15.24 cm diameter)

E6_spatial.evidence: magnetometer cage (15.24 cm height × 15.24 cm diameter)

E7_social_context.evidence: mice tested individually in magnetometer cage

D1_continuity.evidence: Baseline (60 min) and post-treatment (60 min) recorded in immediate succession on the same day

D2_session_duration.evidence: analyzed for 60 min with jackets applied for baseline activity... another 60 min trial period

D3_recording_days.evidence: On the experimental day, mice were placed in a magnetometer cage

D4_baseline.evidence: All mice were initially analyzed for 60 min with jackets applied for baseline activity

judge_notes: Only HTR is a scored behavioural assay; pharmacokinetic plasma/brain sampling is excluded as physiological, not behavioural.

Candidates disagreed on D1 (continuity): the paper describes a 60-min baseline immediately followed by a 60-min post-treatment recording on the same day. Treated as a single continuous session per assay since both phases occur on one day with no gap; conservatively scored 0 (single session) consistent with rubric examples of pre/post within same day.
B7 scored 0: the magnetometer/Clampex/MATLAB pipeline is signal-event detection, not video-based behavioural classification.

setup_habituation scored 'no' because the baseline period is within the same recording session (rubric explicitly excludes acclimation during the test session itself), and no separate pre-test apparatus exposure is described.
Vehicle for DMT not explicitly named in the in vivo methods; set to not_reported.
